svg.text: B1 — Measurement header MH — jumpers, series resistors, fit / remove
Bird Bend Stand — HW-gate bench pictures
MH: 2 × 8 pins on the interface board, GND next to every signal, jumper wires ≤ 10 cm (wiring §6.1)
label the built header with exactly these names (E, GR-3)
jumper → series R at the MCU end → MCU pin
selector PA10, PB0, PC1, PB6, PB4…
selector PB4, PB10, PA2, PA7, PA8…
stimulus PB8 → input connector (§6.8, HG-11, HG-29)
stimulus flows PB8 → connector; 220 Ω, NOT 1 kΩ (REQ-A-M2-07)
HG-01 continuity (tap → MCU pin): 950…1100 Ω each; J-STIM 209…240 Ω
MH pins are digital inputs without pull in every image: the jumpers may stay fitted with the release image (HG-31).
J-EVT / J-AUX / J-STIM per step (HW_GATE_RUNBOOK v0.4 §4 — the runner's prompt is binding)
